coverage.summary: Applies statewide to residential leases, tenancies at will and rentals, except leases, rentals, occupancies or tenancies of 100 days or less for a vacation or recreational purpose.
coverage.other_conditions: Excludes leases, rentals, occupancies or tenancies of 100 days or less for a vacation or recreational purpose (subsection 9).

evidence.quoted_span: The provisions of this section shall not apply to any lease, rental, occupancy or tenancy of one hundred days or less in duration which lease or rental is for a vacation or recreational purpose.
No lease relating to residential real property
within thirty days after the termination of occupancy under a tenancy-at-will or the end of the tenancy as specified in a valid written lease agreement
The provisions of this section shall not apply to any lease, rental, occupancy or tenancy of one hundred days or less in duration which lease or rental is for a vacation or recreational purpose.

result.notes: The original coverage is supported by D052. The vacation-rental exclusion was reworded slightly to match subsection (9), which covers leases, rentals, occupancies or tenancies. No unit-count, construction-date, owner-occupancy, landlord-size or preemption limits appear in § 15B, so those fields stay null. The c. 40P and Cella documents concern rent control, not this rule's coverage.
